summary: Completed comprehensive testing of revised fillet product detection feature in Pembelian Baru (New Purchase) form. All backend APIs and frontend UI components working correctly with 100% test success rate.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login with owner/admin123 returns valid token
Backend: GET /api/products returns new fields (is_fillet, is_purchasable, purchase_unit) for all products
Backend: Ayam Fillet & Dada Fillet correctly identified as fillet (is_fillet=true, is_purchasable=true, purchase_unit='pcs')
Backend: Ayam Broiler correctly identified as whole chicken (is_fillet=false, is_purchasable=true, purchase_unit='ekor')
Backend: Ceker Ayam & Dada Ayam correctly marked as non-purchasable (is_purchasable=false, purchase_unit=null)
Backend: Created test product 'Paha FILLET Test' with name containing 'fillet' in non-fillet category - correctly detected as fillet
Backend: Created test product 'Tenderloin Test' with category='fillet' but name without 'fillet' - correctly detected as fillet
Backend: POST /api/purchases with 2 fillet lines (Dada Fillet: 5 pcs supplier→10 pcs after, Ayam Fillet: 3 pcs) + 1 whole chicken (Ayam Broiler: 10 ekor) - all items saved correctly
Backend: Purchase response items show correct qty_unit ('pcs' for fillets, 'ekor' for whole chicken)
Backend: Dada Fillet item shows pcs_supplier=5, pcs=10, buy_price_pcs=20000 (correct)
Backend: Ayam Fillet item shows pcs_supplier=3, pcs=3, buy_price_pcs=33333.33 (correct)
Backend: Ayam Broiler item shows qty_unit='ekor', ekor=10 (correct)
Backend: Stock updates accurate - Dada Fillet +4 kg & +10 pcs (ekor unchanged), Ayam Fillet +2.4 kg & +3 pcs (ekor unchanged), Ayam Broiler +20 kg & +10 ekor
Backend: Stock updates applied to SPECIFIC products only (no cross-contamination between Dada Fillet and Ayam Fillet)
Backend: PUT /api/purchases/{id} (Koreksi) - changed Dada Fillet to pcs_after=12, total_weight=4.5 - stock adjusted correctly to +4.5 kg & +12 pcs from baseline
Backend: DELETE /api/purchases/{id} - all stocks (Dada Fillet, Ayam Fillet, Ayam Broiler) restored to baseline
Backend: POST /api/purchases with non-purchasable product (Ceker Ayam) returns 400 with correct Indonesian error message mentioning fillet
Frontend: Login with owner/admin123 successful
Frontend: Navigation to /pembelian (Purchases page) works
Frontend: Click 'Pembelian Baru' button opens purchase dialog
Frontend: Product dropdown (data-testid='pur-item-0') lists only purchasable products
Frontend: Dropdown includes Ayam Broiler, Ayam Kampung, Ayam Pejantan with 'ekor' badge
Frontend: Dropdown includes Ayam Fillet, Dada Fillet with 'fillet · pcs' badge
Frontend: Dropdown does NOT include Ceker Ayam, Dada Ayam, or other non-purchasable products
Frontend: Selecting Dada Fillet changes label from 'Jumlah (ekor)' to 'Jumlah (pcs)'
Frontend: 'Total Pcs Setelah Dipotong' field (data-testid='pur-pcs-after-0') appears for fillet products
Frontend: Filled Dada Fillet: Jumlah=5, Berat=4, Total Harga=200000, Total Pcs Setelah Dipotong=10
Frontend: 'Harga/pcs (otomatis)' (data-testid='pur-price-pcs-0') shows Rp 20.000 (correct calculation: 200000/10)
Frontend: Average weight guidance (data-testid='pur-avg-0') shows '0,4 kg/pcs' and 'stok Dada Fillet bertambah 4 kg & 10 pcs'
Frontend: Added second item (Ayam Broiler) - label remains 'Jumlah (ekor)', no pcs_after field (correct)
Frontend: Added third item (Ayam Fillet) with Jumlah=3, Berat=2.4, Total Harga=100000
Frontend: Summary section (data-testid='pur-total-pcs') shows 'Jumlah Fillet (masuk stok)' with '8 pcs supplier → 13 pcs'
Frontend: Per-product breakdown lists both 'Dada Fillet' (5→10 pcs · 4 kg · Rp 20.000/pcs) and 'Ayam Fillet' (3 pcs · 2,4 kg · Rp 33.333/pcs)
Frontend: Summary 'Perkiraan Harga/pcs (otomatis)' (data-testid='pur-price-pcs') shows Rp 23.077 (correct average)
Frontend: Click 'Simpan' (data-testid='save-purchase') - success toast 'tersimpan' appears
Frontend: Purchase appears in table with correct data
Frontend: Click 'Koreksi' (data-testid='edit-purchase-{id}') opens edit dialog with title 'Koreksi Pembelian'
Frontend: Edit dialog loads Dada Fillet with Jumlah (pcs)=5 and Total Pcs Setelah Dipotong=10 (correct)
Frontend: Edit dialog loads Ayam Fillet with Jumlah=3 (correct)
Frontend: Click 'Hapus' (data-testid='delete-purchase-{id}') and confirm (data-testid='confirm-delete-purchase') - success toast 'dihapus' appears
